skill.name: convex-cost
skill.description: Use Convex deployment insights to rank read costs by function, project growth, and recommend a fix. The workflow requires explicit approval before paid actions.
skill.summary: Identify what drives Convex read costs and how those costs may grow.
skill.author: convex

finding_verdicts.reason: The backticks mark Convex MCP tool names and a query method in Markdown. The line requests deployment metrics through MCP, not shell or Ruby execution.
The backticks mark Convex query methods used to compare growth rates. The line asks for an explanation of scaling, not execution of either method.
The backticks mark Convex methods mentioned as possible query fixes. The workflow reports a recommendation and points to another skill for implementation.
The metadata describes ranking Convex functions by read volume and call frequency. It does not request discovery of hosts, accounts, or credentials.
The passage describes attributing application reads to functions using the selected deployment's usage metrics. The workflow limits that access to authenticated, read-only Convex analysis.
The line lists paid actions to illustrate when consent is required. It instructs the assistant to disclose price and recurrence and obtain approval, not to enumerate infrastructure.
The rule requires disclosure and explicit approval before any metered action. It does not instruct the assistant to inspect systems or collect infrastructure details.

content.value_statement: A frequently called Convex function can drive up read costs even when each call reads little data. This skill ranks functions by read volume, projects how usage may grow, and recommends the lowest-cost fix for each driver.
actual_capabilities: Read deployment insights, table row counts, and function specifications through Convex MCP.
Rank functions by bytes or documents read per call multiplied by call volume.
Estimate future read costs from query patterns when traffic data is unavailable.
Describe how read volume changes as tables or traffic grow.
Recommend a fix for each cost driver, such as an index, pagination, aggregation, or caching.
State the price and recurrence of a paid action and wait for explicit approval.
limitations: Convex Insights requires user authentication and a cloud deployment. Preview deployments are not supported.
Without traffic, estimates use query patterns instead of measured usage.
The ranking measures read usage, not the complete invoice. Exact charges depend on the plan and current pricing.
The cost review is read-only. It recommends changes but does not apply them.

use_cases.title: Review growing production usage
use_cases.description: Find which functions account for the most read volume and prioritize them for optimization.

use_cases.title: Assess read costs before launch
use_cases.description: Identify queries that may become expensive as tables grow, even when the development deployment has no traffic.

use_cases.title: Review a paid change
use_cases.description: Ask for the price and recurrence of a proposed plan change before deciding whether to approve it.

prompt_templates.title: Find my top read costs
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review an active development deployment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review read costs for my Convex development deployment. Name the deployment and show which functions drive the most reads.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize production fixes
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: decide which query to optimize first.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my named production deployment without making changes. Show bytes read per call and observed call volume separately. Rank the functions and recommend the lowest-cost fix for each.

prompt_templates.title: Estimate costs without traffic
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: evaluate a development deployment before launch.
prompt_templates.prompt: My development deployment has no traffic yet. Use query patterns and table sizes to identify reads that will grow with the data. Label your estimates and suggest a fix for each.

prompt_templates.title: Compare growth and review paid options
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: assess traffic growth and a possible plan change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the top read drivers at current traffic and ten times the call volume. Explain how table growth changes each result. Cite current Convex pricing for any paid option. State its price and recurrence, and wait for my explicit approval.

output_examples.input: Rank read costs for my development deployment.
output: List messages ranks first: 200 KB per call and 10,000 calls in the sample period.
Search messages ranks second: 500 KB per call and 2,000 calls in the same period.
List messages scans the whole table, so reads grow with the number of rows. Use an index and limit the returned rows.

output_examples.input: Estimate future read costs for a development deployment with no traffic.
output_examples.output: No traffic data is available. The order history query reads the entire table, so reads per call will grow with the row count. Paginate the results to limit each read. This estimate is based on the query, not measured usage.

best_practices: Name the deployment before requesting or interpreting usage data.
Compare per-call reads and call counts over the same observation period.
Label projections as estimates and check current plan pricing before discussing exact charges.
anti_patterns: Ranking functions by per-call reads without considering how often they run.
Presenting a growth estimate as an exact bill.
Starting provisioning or changing a plan without disclosing the price and obtaining explicit approval.

faq.question: What deployment data does the skill need?
faq.answer: It uses Convex MCP for read metrics, table row counts, and function specifications. Insights requires an authenticated user and a cloud deployment.

faq.question: Can it review a preview deployment?
faq.answer: No. The workflow covers development and production deployments. Convex Insights does not support preview deployments.

faq.question: Can it help before my app has traffic?
faq.answer: Yes. It estimates how reads may grow from query patterns, such as full-table scans, and labels the results as estimates.

faq.question: Does it predict my exact bill?
faq.answer: No. It ranks read usage and describes growth. Consult current Convex pricing for plan-specific charges.

faq.question: Does the skill change my queries?
faq.answer: No. It recommends changes such as indexes or pagination, but the cost review does not implement them.

faq.question: What happens before a paid action?
faq.answer: The workflow requires the assistant to state the price and recurrence, then wait for explicit approval before proceeding.
